balls.text: shuffles across, Khaleel bowls it between the batter and the stumps, Salt throws the ball back and the batters don't run. Dot ball to end the innings
a cutter that's banged in short and wide, and Rawat slashes it to deep point. Just one more
low full toss swinging in from outside off, hit hard but down to long-off for just one
slow cutter into the pitch and gets some bounce too, Rawat pulls it to long-on for one
First ball six! That'a gift from Khaleel. Full toss down the leg side and Rawat swings it over the fine leg boundary, that's a short boundary there
caught at long-off! A low and wide full toss, Karthik swings big and nearly gets it across the rope but Warner goes to his left and pouches it easily from long-off
swings big for the full ball outside off, along the ground to long-off for one
a wide yorker, Karthik wants to steer it away but misses

drilled through the covers for four! Excellent shot to bring up an excellent fifty from Lomror. Stays still till the end and uses his strength to make the ball race away alone the ground for four from outside off

nails the yorker, Karthik is three-fourths down the pitch, Mukesh picks the ball up and has a shy at the non-striker's end but Karthik has clearly changed his path and run right in the middle of the pitch. Mukesh can't hit the stumps, and they don't even appeal for obstructing the field

wants to play the scoop, Mukesh appeals for lbw as the ball goes fine on leg, it's given lbw straightaway and also reviewed straightaway! Lomror was all the way across apart from his right leg, and there's some bat before the ball hits the pad right in front of the stumps. Third umpire thinks it's a deviation but wants to check UltraEdge, which is taking ages and ages to load. We'll catch you all tomorrow. Oh it's here. There's a spike and it's not out

Karthik launches this one into the stands behind square! This is the DK RCB wanted. He shuffles across a bit because Khaleel is bowling wide from the crease and around the wicket, uses the angle and middles that with a pick-up shot over long leg
a full toss down the leg side past the bat, and they run one as well after it goes off the keeper's gloves
one bounce to sweeper cover for a single. Full and wide, Karthik finally middles one and launches it in the air but can't find the gap
on the pads, wants to tickle it fine, but it's only a leg bye for one
nipping in towards the stumps, Lomror swings on the leg side, gets a thick outside edge and it flies away between the keeper and short third for four! Luck
full and wide again, drilled along the ground to long-off
wide yorker is a wide full toss, Karthik swings and misses! Opportunity missed

a direct hit but he's home. Good ball to end the over, Ishant lands an offcutter towards the stumps which Karthik can't get on top of, swipes on the leg side, and only manages a quick one. A direct hit from short fine leg but Lomror made it well in time
slow just outside off, he whips it to leg and wants two but the fielder swoops in quickly from the deep to keep it to one
scythed through point for four! Just a bit of width, some angle, and Lomror stays on the back foot and slices it late enough to beat point for a cracking four
bangs it in short outside off, Karthik wants to help it very fine and beat short third but he can't, and gets one to the fielder
short of length and outside off, it's slow as well, and Lomror stays on top while helping it to off for one
a wide yorker but just outside the blue line and wide again
slow and too wide outside off, called wide
smacked to the cover boundary! Angling across outside off from length, Lomror uses his strength to hammer it over the covers to crash it into the LED boards

Kohli finds short fine leg! That was juggle that could put any circus expert to shame! Kohli flicked the ball straight to Khaleel, and he got both hands to it, then juggled, juggled, and tried and tried, and kept tossing the ball close to his chest before finally clinging on to it. That was about eight to 10 attempts there. Not kidding
almost in the block hole on leg, Kohli takes two more by working it to deep square leg
an attempted yorker gone wrong for a wide down leg
full on the stumps and he bunts it down to long-on for one
there are four men in the deep on leg, he makes room to target the off side, Lomror lands it near his pads, and Lomror flicks it away in the gap behind square for four. Excellent placement
full on middle, nearly in the block hole again, and push down to long-on this time
starts with a yorker, which Kohli nudges down to long-on and sprints back for the second
the crowd erupts to see the local boy get a fifty with a pull down to long-on. Fifty off 42 balls
uses hard hands to go after that one outside off, single to deep cover
full on the pads, flicked straight to short fine, and Lomror is off the blocks quickly for one
slow, full and wide, goes down on a knee and finds a single to long-off
too short, towards the hips, and Lomror pulls it for another big six! Targets the shorter boundary and lands another one in the stands
short and slow cutter, pretty wide too, and Kohli reaches out for it for a single to deep cover
pitches it shorter and Kohli goes back to work it to leg for one
nearly gets off stump! Kohli gets one outside off and it's turning in, he goes for a big slog sweep and misses it completely. Kuldeep knows how close that was
flat and into middle now, nudged to leg for one
down the ground this time and this one goes all the way! Pitched up on off, Lomror swing big and down the ground, and clears long-off with a clean hit
one-bounce four off a reverse sweep! On length on off, Lomror takes out the reverse quickly and middles the reverse this time
shortish on leg, he goes back and whips to leg for one
much fuller outside off, he slices and finds point
shuffles down, Ishant pitches it much shorter and outside off, he scythes to deep point for one
slower one on middle and leg, Kohli tickles it to leg with soft hands and wants two. He gets those two as well because of his quick running
outside leg, Lomror finds short fine leg, and Kohli wants a single straightaway
slower one on the stumps, looked like a knuckle ball, and he turns it to leg for one
lofted beautifully over the covers for four! RCB need more such boundaries. Not too full, but in the slot for Kohli to stay still and then loft it while continuing to stay still, over the covers
fuller outside off, he slices off the back foot and hares back for the second run in time
really tight line and length on the stumps with some turn, it was quick as well, and Lomror defends it to off
errs with the length, it's too short, and Lomrom rocks back for the pivot and pulls it for a massive six into the stands!
changes his stance for the reverse, Kuldeep bowls a googly and it hits him in front of off, probably missing off
flat on leg, no turn, and Kohli works it off the pads for one to leg
nice turn for the length ball on off, he leans forward and gets a single to cover point
pretty wide to end the over and he scythes it to deep point for one
back of length outside off, he punches it towards cover off the back foot

first ball duck for Maxwell! Marsh gets his mate caught behind, the stadium erupts. This wasn't the slower one, Maxwell tries to scythe it off the back foot and the ball gets good bounce from back of length, gets a thin outside edge and straight into Salt's hands

that's the first wicket of the game and it's the more dangerous batter gone! Marsh's slow and wide ball works this time because du Plessis goes after this one on the off side, takes the aerial route, but there's no pace at all, and he finds deep cover
127.6kmh, angling into middle and leg, and Kohli shuffles down to flick it to leg for one
slow legcutting bouncer well outside off, pulled hard to the leg side for one
slower one is pretty wide down leg, called a wide
86.1kmh, slows it down on middle stump and du Plessis pokes it towards cover for one
86.8kmh, too much on leg and turning down further, runs it down to fine leg for one more
some flight and turn on off, not much though, and he goes back to pinch a single to leg
the wrong'un but it's on leg so Kohli knows it going to come towards off stump, and it's short as well so he whips it with hard hands along the ground to leg
little slower on middle and leg, now he tucks it behind square for one
short and flat on leg, whips it between long-on and deep midwicket and Warner dives to his right in the deep to save two
opens up on the back foot this time and whips it to long-on for one. Keeps strike
full on off, smoked over the bowler's head for four! Du Plessis keeps his solid base and uses his strong arms to smack it back

Du PLessis makes room this time and misses after trying to smack it away. There's an appeal for caught behind and Delhi Capitals review it. The ball was right on off stump when du Plessis went after it, and UltraEdge shows there's nothing. They don't check the stumping though
makes room early for the length ball around off, pushes wide of cover for one more
goes back for the shorter ball and whips it to leg for one
angling in on middle, thick inside edge to leg for one
generously flighted on leg stump, full as well, and Kohli flicks it along the ground for one
goes back for the short ball which doesn't bounce much and pulls it to leg for one
some more flight, and it's the googly on middle, he waits and pushes to cover again
more flight for du Plessis on leg, he pushes to cover
88.3kmh, on length on off now, he works it towards midwicket for one
hit first ball for four! Flat on leg, turning in as well at 85.9kmh, Kohli rocks on the back foot and tucks it square in the big gap for four!
118.6kmh, five slower ones out of six. Kohli comes out for this one and swings across the line for a single to the right of long-on for one
117kmh, slow and short legcutter well outside off, another pull to leg from du Plessis
117.3kmh, another slower and shorter one, but this one bounces a little more and Kohli manages to slap it back to long-off
slow and short cutter well outside off, he pulls it to leg with his long reach for one
132kmh, short of length on middle and Kohli tucks it to leg for one more
starts with a slower ball t 118.5kmh outside off and du Plessis steers it to deep point for one
128.3kmh, slow and angling into the stumps from wide of the crease, du Plessis flicks it in the air to deep square leg for one
the expected short ball after the full ball, du Plessis is expecting it too, and he opens up quickly to pull it away to the wide long-on boundary for four more

he ran for that quick single because he wants runs! Gets a low full toss on off and he's not going to let that go away. clears the front leg and lofts it straight down the ground for the first six of the game!
143.2kmh, Khaleel pitches it up and angles it in from wide of the crease, gets only an edge to short fine leg and du Plessis takes off immediately for a quick single
angling in a bit too much and Kohli uses that to flick it square for two in the gap
too full, du Plessis tries to hit it hard past mid-on but doesn't middle it and only gets one to mid-on
excellent reply from Mukesh. Finds the block hole and du Plessis digs it out to mid-on for one
top edge over the keeper for four more! Mukesh bangs it in short on off and middle, du Plessis opens up for a hook and only manages an edge which is enough to make the ball fly over the keeper
over mid-on for four this time! Slower one outside off, too short as well which gave du Plessis even more time and he opened up to slap it over mid-on
oh this time he comes down again and swings on the off side but misses it. And the ball just misses the off stump!

charges down and drills it back past the bowler for his first four! That was good adjustment from du Plessis because when he came down, Mukesh bowled it tight on the stumps, and instead of swinging wildly or over the top, du Plessis smacked it right back along the ground
starts with a tight line on off stump, du Plessis steers it to cover point
stays back to whip it on leg but the short and quick ball hits him on the pads towards leg
88.8kmh, he's keeping it fairly slow and on the stumps. Du Plessis pushes this length ball down to long-off again
on the pads, worked to square leg for one more
stays back and punches the short of length ball down to long-off for one
makes room early, Axar pitches it wide of the batter outside off and it turns away too, making him reach out for it. And it keeps low as well to beat the bat
short, slow and into the pads, worked to square leg
dances down to swing big but Ishant cramps him again with the angle, but this time Kohli gets two towards deep midwicket
beats him! Beautiful ball for a reply. Pitches it on length outside off and moves it away as well to beat Kohli's poke
pulled handsomely! A 142kmh bouncer towards the head, Kohli hangs back and pulls it with some power, right into the ground and the ball races away to square leg

run out chance! Slower ball almost in the block hole which Kohli smacks back, Ishant gets a hand to it and picks it up quickly to have a shy at the stumps because Kohli has ventured out. It's not a direct hit but Kohli dives back to make his ground
he charges down, Ishant angles it into Kohli and he's cramped for room. Defends it back
nipping in slightly outside off, but enough width for du Plessis to run it down to deep third for one
some turn to end the over too. Pitches on off, turns away and Kohli helps it to cover point
a bit too short, Kohli sees width outside off and cuts it away right in between point and cover point for four
92.,8kmh, looked slower but it's flat on middle, du Plessis gets a thick inside edge to square leg for one
short and darting in with the arm, Kohli works it towards square leg for one
turn straightaway! Flighted just outside off, Kohli swings big on the leg side but he's beaten completely and he manages to drag his back foot inside the crease
starts with a length ball on the stumps, Kohli blocks it back
finishes right on target on middle stump, Kohli opens the face of the bat late to steer to point. a needless overthrow to the keeper leaks one
in the air again and in the gap again! On middle and leg, not so full, and Kohli flicks it in the air between mid-on and midwicket for two more
134.2kmh, now on middle and leg with some outswing, Kohli waits on the back foot and wants to steal a single with a tap on off but he's sent back
not as wide but still pretty short, angling away too and Kohli leaves again

slashes it in the air but also in the gap between mid-off and cover, the crowd waits for a second to see the ball lands in the gap and then breaks out into a rapturous noise. It was short and wide, and Kohli pounced on it
starts with some outswing on length around off stump, angles it away as well and Kohli leaves it
Victory sealed with a six! Hammers this over midwicket and Delhi Capitals are off the bottom of the table!
Darts it in full on middle, he clips it to midwicket
On a length outside off, he goes back and punches it out to cover
On a length outside off, Rossouw chips it back and Maxwell can't get there! Just goes past the non-striker and that was at a very catch-able height
On a length on off, Rossouw goes back and punches it out to long-off
Tossed up full on middle, he digs it out to mid-off for a single
And Axar starts off with a maximum! This is full outside off and Axar gets down on one knee and hammers it over cow corner

Beauty to end Salt's assault! Tossed up full on leg, Salt goes back and plays all around it as the ball deflects off his pads onto the off-stump. He goes for 87 off 45, essentially having wrapped the match up for his team today!
Too straight for long-off and Salt gets four more. Full on off, Salt clears his front leg and hits it past the bowler
On a length on middle, he nudges it through midwicket for a single
Drops a length ball just behind point and they sneak a quick run
Length ball on middle, he pulls it between deep midwicket and long-on and gets a brace
Hazlewood nails the wide yorker and Rossouw can only get bat on it and steer it to short third
Full on off and he flicks it to deep backward square and gets two
On a length around off and he rocks back and pulls it hard into the ground and back to the bowler
Went for the yorker but it turns into a low full toss. Salt gets his bat down in time to jam it back out over the bowler for a single
On a length outside off, Salt swings hard but misses as the ball goes through to Karthik
Full on off, defended back to the bowler
On a length around off and he drives to cover
Dragged down on off and deep midwicket had no chance there! Salt rocks back and muscles a pull over the fielder stationed in the deep
Clips this flat delivery out to deep midwicket for a single
Full on leg, Salt nudges it away through the vacant midwicket area for a quick single
Last thing that RCB needed! A single becomes for as a length ball is slapped away to long-off where Prabhudessai lets it slip between his hands!
Swung high and handsome over long-on. Full on leg and he backs away, makes room and clears the ropes with ease
Short slower ball outside off that he leaves alone. It's called wide
Full outside off, he taps it square on the off side
Shot! Full outside off and Rossow leans into it and sends it flying 94 metres straight back down the ground
Another full toss and he flicks it aerially to deep square
This time, the full toss from Harshal is punished. Low full toss on off and Salt almost nonchalantly flicks it over cow corner
Googly outside off, he defends towards point and wants a quick single but is sent back by Salt

Misses the reverse-sweep and Hasaranga thinks he has his man. They review it! This was tossed up full outside off and spinning in. Looks like no bat or glove on that. Impact will be the point of contention. And yes, it's outside, so Rossouw survives
Wrong'un from around the wicket outside off. He plays it to point
Clips it out to deep midwicket
Quick brace to mid-on! Short ball that he clipped through the vacant area
Lovely delivery but no rewards. On a length outside off and it zips past the outside edge. Deflects off Karthik's gloves onto the stumps but Salt was well inside
Full outside off, Rossouw makes room and slaps it over cover. Sweeper comes in and stops the boundary
Wide yorker and Rossouw is able to squeeze it back out to the bowler's right
Slower ball just behind good length outside off, he waits on it and nudges it out towards long-on. A misfield allows them to run the second
Oh, he has picked out deep square leg off the full toss! Low full toss going down leg and Marsh looks to flick it away. It goes up high and falls to Lomror, who takes a simple catch
Full and wide of off and Marsh frees his arms and goes inside out over cover. Lands just inside the rope and it will be four more for Capitals
Starts off with a short ball outside off. Marsh reaches out and chops it back to the keeper off the inside edge that bounces past the stumps
On a length on off, punched out to cover
Dropped short outside off, this time he goes back and slaps it out to long off
Full outside off, Salt gets a thick outside edge that beats short third and gives Capitals four more runs
Full around off and he plays it back to the bowler
Oh you don't bowl it there to him today, Mahipal! Long hop sits up nicely and Salt goes back and muscles this over cow corner
Tossed up full on middle, Marsh backs away and drives to sweeper cover
Fifty up in style! Too short on off and he rocks back and pulls it in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on. Brings up 100 for the Capitals as well
Tossed up on leg, he clears his front leg and swings this away along the ground to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, he goes back and punches it past cover off the back foot. Gets two as the sweeper cover cleans up
Tossed up on leg, he clips it to long-on for a single
Too short, too wide and put away. Salt reaches out and hammers this in front of point
Oh that misses everything and races away for four! On a length outside leg, he backs away to pull it away and misses and it goes through DK's legs
On a length on leg, he goes back and punches it back past the bowler to long-off
Clips it out to wide long-on for a single
Darts it in quicker and full on leg, he defends back to the bowler
On a length outside off, spinning in, and he goes back and cuts this out to sweeper cover
Tossed up on a length on leg, he punches this to wide long-on for a single
That wrong'un is too short and Marsh rocks back and pulls it imperiously through midwicket
Short and wide and he slaps it hard but it's straight to Faf du Plessis at point
Tossed up full on leg, he clips it out to wide long-on for a single
Short on middle, he rocks back and cuts it past cover and to the sweeper
Inside out and in the gap. Full on off and he backs away and drives this over cover. One bounce and four and beats the sweeper as well as long-off
Fuller on leg, Salt whips it away through the vacant midwicket and gets a quick brace
Beats him first up. Sharp legbreak on a length on middle and off. Salt goes back to cut but is beaten on the outside edge

Back of a length on off, Marsh goes for the pull and under-edges it onto the ground but the ball rolls away through backward square with no fielder there as Capitals finish the powerplay with momentum solidly on their side despite the wicket this over
On a length on off, Marsh blocks it and the ball goes towards midwicket
On a length outside off, pace off, and Marsh guides it to cover
That's hammered ten rows back. Length ball on off sits up nicely and Marsh swings across the line and boshes it over midwicket
Full on off, Marsh moves across and punches it past the bowler to mid-off

Skiiiiied and taken. Full outside off and Warner went for the big shot. The ball went up high in the air and Faf du Plessis takes it reverse-cupped just in front of his face as he fell back at mid-off
On a length outside leg, Warner opens the face of the bat to steer it to point
Nails the wide yorker and Salt squeezes it out to backward point
On a length outside off, jags in and beats Salt's inside edge as he looks to swing
Banged in short, and it flies over Salt. It's called wide. Siraj is having some angry words at Warner and Salt. Du Plessis takes Siraj away and calms him down.
This time a one-bounce four! On a length outside off and Salt walks out and flicks this over in front of square
Fifty up in style for Delhi capitals. This is short outside off and Salt throws his arms at it and slaps it over cover and into the first row
Top edge goes high in the air and lands in the stands above the sightscreen! Siraj banged it in short and Salt went for the pull. The ball went up high behind the keeper and into the sightscreen
Sharp legbreak on a length on middle and off, Warner goes back and defends this
Four more for Warner. Dropped short on middle and leg and Warner rocks back and pulls it through midwicket
Is that a drop? Googly outside off and it takes a thin inside edge that deflects it onto Karthik's thighs, past his gloves.
Cuts it out to Faf du Plessis at cover, who is quick to throw it to the striker's end but the batters make ground
Tossed up on leg and David Warner is quick to get down and slog-sweep this behind square! Great start this, for Delhi Capitals
Oh that's brilliantly played. Hazlewood bangs it in short and Salt just helps it on it's way over backward square. The ball bounces just over the rope
On a length just outside off. Salt drives to extra cover and the crowd goes up in cheer as Kohli moves to his left and stretches to stop the ball in a good piece of fielding
Short ball on leg, Warner goes to pull but inside edges it onto the ground and out to backward square
Length ball outside off and Salt gets an outside edge to deep third
Length ball outside off jags in and hits Salt on the thigh as he misses his flick
Top edge and over Maxwell at fly slip! On a length outside off, Salt skipped out and had a big swing and got a thick edge. Hit it hard enough that it flew over the keeper and fly slip
Big shout for lbw as Salt misses an attempted reverse-sweep. Was that pitching outside leg? They don't review it. It was on a length and Salt got nothing on it as he looked to innovate
Hammers it away! Too short on leg and Salt rocks back and pulls in front of deep square leg
On a length on leg, Salt goes back and defends
Short outside off, Warner backs away and punches it out to long-off
Edged and just shy of short third! Maxwell tosses it up outside off and he goes for the drive. Takes the edge and balloons up but falls short of the fielder
Lobs it up on a length outside leg, Salt goes back and punches it out to mid-on
Squares him up a little with a length ball on leg. Warner looks to clip it leg-side but it goes to the point fielder off his pads. Salt wanted a single but is sent back
Full outside off and angling in, Salt defends towards cover and takes a quick single
Fuller on leg, Warner looks to clip it away but misses. It drops in front on the leg side off his pads and the batters steal the leg-bye
Thwacks him through midwicket now! It's short on off and Warner pulls it over the infielder and the ball runs away
Good comeback by Siraj. Goes on a length on off, Warner looks to cut but the ball zips past the outside edge
Warner off the mark in style. It's slightly back of length and going across him and he frees his arms and slaps it past cover's right
